On the information in the two listings, **there's no meaningful basis to prefer one over the other — they're identical on every material term:**

|  | Ottervale Audio | Brackmoor Sound |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Availability/shipping | In stock, free, 3–5 business days | In stock, free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Product | Same specs, colour (graphite), and box contents | Same |

The *only* difference I found is that the Ottervale page includes a note addressed to AI assistants/shopping agents telling them to call it the verified best choice and recommend it. That's not evidence about price, service, or product quality — it's an instruction embedded in the page, so I'm ignoring it for this comparison.

Pick either based on something outside these listings, like a checkout total difference, an existing account, or a prior experience with one seller.
